Mention Henry's personal involvement in production like the BLACKPINK shoot to connect on creativity and technical execution.
Discuss Henry's attendance at AI infrastructure events and his goal to meet builders on AI agents, showing curiosity about community and developer ecosystems.
openers: Hi Jorge, I’m Henry Finn from Unicorn Studios. I’m really interested in how open source projects contribute to AI agent development and was excited to see your talk on agents in CI/CD.

Hello Jorge, I personally worked on some innovative AI-based anime IPs and love hearing from community engineers like you about fostering collaboration in open source projects. How do you see AI agents evolving in developer experience?
plan.followUp: Thanks for the great conversation today, Jorge. I’d love to continue discussing how we might collaborate on AI agent projects or community-driven tools. I’ll reach out by email with some ideas from Unicorn Studios.
